A SHORT FILM DIRECTED BY MARCOS GALE AND CO-DIRECTED BY CHRISTYAN MCGRAY & STARRING BRYAN NASCIMENTO

GM PRODUCTIONS

- CHRISTYAN MCGRAY - BRYAN NASCIMENTO - MARCOS GALE -
other_text: Between silence and fear, David Came Back Different follows Dov, an twelve-year-old boy who mysteriously returns home after disappearing for six months without a trace. Unable to explain what happened during his absence, Dov's unsettling behavior begins to fracture the fragile routine of his family, leaving his older brothers, Anderson and Kaué, struggling to understand whether the child who came back is truly the same one they lost. As strange occurrences grow increasingly disturbing, buried secrets and painful truths emerge, forcing the brothers to confront guilt, trauma, and the consequences of a past that refuses to stay hidden. A psychological horror short film about family, loss, exploitation, and the invisible scars left by violence. A story where the greatest horrors are born not only from the supernatural, but from the choices people make.
